events.title: Scatec and NBE sign agreement for equity partnership in Obelisk project
events.body: The addition of NBE as an equity partner is part of Scatec’s strategy to optimise capital efficiency across its portfolio.

events.title: Lyra Energy inks deal with commercial clients for 255MW solar project
events.body: Scatec will oversee EPC, asset management and O&M for the solar project.
